rationale: The replication successfully reproduces the headline magnitude claim that orbital magnetization suppression R can exceed 50% with ~1% impurities (mean R≈49%, reaching 83% at small η). However, the paper's more subtle and central claim—that R is qualitatively insensitive to η—was NOT reproduced; instead R decreases monotonically with η (83%→9.5%), matching the naive expectation the paper argues against. The clean M_orb~η³ scaling was also not recovered. These failures stem from using an open flake rather than the paper's periodic supercell with k-space formula, which truncates the nonlocal circulation effects. Core physics confirmed at order-of-magnitude level, but key theoretical insight not validated.
